header: The "Source" bar above a health check-up answer: which circular the answer was read from (the number and year the archive shows, and its title) with a plain "Open circular" button. A click opens the circular in the same viewer the archive and the search use, at the page where the people in the answer are listed, with a marker on that page: one click to check the answer against the original. I put it above the table, not under it, so it is seen without scrolling and nobody has to find it by chance. When someone listed is not in the HR directory it says so, here, and only then.

doc: Gives "page 5" / "pages 5, 6, 8" (nothing when the page is not known).

behaviours: pages in words: none, one, several
each circular: 'Source:', its number and year, its title and its page(s)
the way in is a visible BUTTON with the words 'Open circular' (not a bare icon or an unmarked link)
each button has an accessible name and a tooltip that say what it opens and why
it is a labelled group for screen readers
a title typed in capitals is shown in running letters (the stored title is not changed)
a circular whose page is unknown is still shown, without 'page' text
the note about unconfirmed people appears in the bar when there is one
...and nothing about HR appears when there is no note
a title or note containing HTML is shown as text, never run
clicking each button passes that circular's id and pages to the viewer: (23, [5]) (30, [3,4,8]) (37, [])
